gloss: to fall asleep; to go to sleep

definitions.gloss: to fall asleep; to go to sleep
definitions.explanation: A somewhat literary or gentle expression for falling asleep. More elegant than simply {寝|ね}る, often used in narrative, bedtime contexts, or when describing someone drifting off peacefully.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{眠|ねむ}りについた。
⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{眠|ねむ}りにつく。
examples.english: To fall asleep in a warm futon.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|ゆうべ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠り：13673_nemuri⟧につけなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't fall asleep last night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れていた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{横|よこ}になる→横になる：05546_yokoninaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ついた。
examples.english: I was tired, so I fell asleep as soon as I lay down.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠り：13673_nemuri⟧ (sleep, as a noun) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (particle) + つく (to settle into). Literally "to settle into sleep." The verb つく conjugates normally: {眠|ねむ}りについた (past), ⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠り：13673_nemuri⟧につける (potential), ⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠り：13673_nemuri⟧につけない (negative potential).

More refined than ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧, which is the everyday word for sleeping or going to bed. {眠|ねむ}りにつく focuses specifically on the transition into sleep and has a softer, more literary tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{眠|ねむ}りにつく: to fall asleep right away
- ⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠り：13673_nemuri⟧につけない: to have trouble falling asleep
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{眠|ねむ}りにつく: to fall into a deep sleep
- ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{眠|ねむ}りにつく: to fall asleep quietly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧: to sleep; to go to bed — the basic everyday word
- {寝|ね}つく: to fall asleep — similar meaning but more colloquial
- ⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧: to sleep — focuses on the state of being asleep rather than the transition
